children: Algorhythm Holdings closed multiple agreements to accelerate its renewable power strategy. The company acquired substantially all assets of Azure Energy for $23 million in stock, gaining permits, IP, real estate, and power-related contracts for waste- and biomass-to-power projects. Concurrently, Algorhythm secured a 36-month exclusive option to acquire 79.0286% of Azure S.R.L. for $30 million, with flexibility to fund up to half in cash and the rest in Series B Preferred Stock. In a related capital action, Algorhythm exchanged its outstanding Series A Preferred held by Streeterville for a $4.025 million secured pre-paid purchase financing at 9% interest, maturing in three years.
